Githyanki Gish'ra (melee) are a class-like archetype of githyanki NPC encountered throughout Baldur's Gate 3, based on the Dexterity-based Way of the Open Hand Monk.

Involvement

Gish'ra only appear during the attack on the Astral Prism in Act Three.
